predictions: Well, it happened again, and it's Membership Director Heather Bohanan's fault yet again. She (appropriately, dangit) loads up the week 7&14 matchups with lots of really great even battles, and then I regularly post my work weeks of the season. And this past week was no exception. For the first time this season, I got 40% of my picks wrong (yes, barely better than a coin flip, sigh). That 15-10 effort brings me to 117-58 (66.9% correct) for the first half of the season.

Match of the week: (F Div.) One Time @ Cheap Shots. With the impressive re-emergence of the Cheapies, the F race all of a sudden looks to be wholly reinvigorated. The two teams closest to the leader Corks tangle here in a wildly critical matchup. Who is it that gets to be the lead chase team? Let's go with the hot hand, no? Cheap, 13-11.

Match #2: (A Div.) Jonesing for Mugs @ Dart Attack. In what kinda has to be the biggest story of the first half in A, Dart Attack (2nd in B last season) sits ahead of Jonesing (2nd in A last season) at the mid- way point. That's freaking awesome. Can they keep it up? Of course. But will all of Jonesing play this time around? Hmmm… Jones, 14-10.

Match #3: (D Div.) Area 501 @ Nine Lives. After last week's pair of shorthanded nailbiters in D, this is all of a sudden the top two teams matching up to start the second half (didn't I read somewhere that these teams would finish 1-2 this season? :o). Area continues on, 15-9.

Match #4: (H Div.) Bright Side of Flights @ Darts In the Wind, Dude! Bangin has a big lead in H, but 3 of their last 4 wins were super tight. So maybe there is a time for a team to make a run at them? Time for a 0.500 team to start up if they're the chaser. Let's ride the Wind, 14-10.

Match #5: (B Div.) Hump Day! @ Liquor Possee. This was all set to be a monster matchup. Then these two went 1-3 combined in the last two weeks. And now it's a different kind of important. Hump, 14-10.

Match #6: (H Div.) The Blonde Leading the Blind @ 21 Dart Salute. Is it too late for the Lasik-enhanced to make a charge (at least for 2nd)? No way, man. A roll is a roll, and this one continues, 13-11.

Match #7: (E Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Dart Knights. Point of Attack holds the second-largest division lead here at halftime. But the race for 2nd place is not just alive, it's hotly contested. Knights, 13-11.

Match #8: (C Div.) Bottoms Up @ Darty Sanchez. A couple of the Bottoms' wins in the first half were tight, so it's entirely conceivable a 4-2 team could chase them down. Will it be Sanchez? Nah. 14-10.

Match #9: (D Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Main Street Mayhem. So it's that time where we start seeing races to avoid 'bottom-two' finishes, and the one in D is pretty crazy, and it's also kind of the race for 2nd place at the same time. Tight pack here. Bandits, 13-11.
Match #10: (A Div.) Why So Serious? @ Consistently Inconsist. These teams locked in top five spots and combined for nine wins last season. Tougher road this season. Let's be Inconsistent, 14-10.
Match #11: (B Div.) Projectile Dysfunction @ Mulligans Mafia. In a division where the season point totals only vary by 13 points, these two are facing bottom-two slots… for now. Projectile, 13-11.
Match #12: (F Div.) Rippin Darts @ Cary On Our Wayward Darts. Next season's G division race favorites? Rippin takes this, 14-10.
